route: P2 free-falling sphere with perimeter frame clamping, adapted to purchased CFRP plate and PZT-5A

plate.source: User order screenshot and seller product information; nominal, not measured
plate.layup_description: Seller states symmetric 0/90 UD interior with woven 3K surface fabric on both faces

pzt.note: Seller nominal values are not batch calibration; do not combine unrelated PZT-5A datasets without a consistency check

boundary.source: P2 SMS paper PDF p16 Fig17; numerical full-perimeter fixity on PDF p17
boundary.numerical_baseline: idealized clamped edge at the measured inner frame perimeter
boundary.note: Finite clamp width changes clear span; actual fixture is not proven perfectly fixed

paper_parameter_options.source: P2 SMS paper PDF p17 Table2; reference ranges only, not authorized physical test levels

impact.height_definition: Vertical travel from release to first sphere/plate contact
impact.note: m*g*h is incident potential energy, not measured absorbed damage energy or peak force

acquisition.note: Confirm exact chip and board. Standard AD7606 nominal analog -3 dB bandwidth is 22 kHz; sampling rate is not bandwidth

proposed_pilot.coordinate_system: Top view, origin at lower-left outer corner; x along 500 mm, y along 400 mm
proposed_pilot.note: Check clearance against measured fixture, sensor faces and cables; verify acquisition supports pretrigger, otherwise use continuous recording

validation_limits: No calculated impact or voltage response yet
Do not reuse the old [0]8 1.72 mm strip as the purchased plate
Do not interpret a response change as confirmed damage
Do not claim original P2 localization accuracy on this specimen
Mechanical strain/displacement is not a calibrated sensor voltage
